ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a low ratio (approx. 5-10%) of high-intensity (white) pixels localized in circular scar patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-value field across the entire fluke; distinct high-contrast white annular geometries (rings) are distributed in the distal 1/3 of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 88 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; edge topography is significantly jagged with multiple micro-notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing edge leading to rounded, convex-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular/annular white scars (approx. 20-30 individual units) visible on the outer sections of both lobes, appearing as ring-like high-contrast pixel groups.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast grey pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the inner-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-relief textured clusters of calcified biological growths (barnacles) localized at the terminal tips of both flukes and scattered along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical distribution of annular 'ring' scars across the bilateral symmetry of the fluke lobes.
